title: Nonhalting persists backward along a run
statement: Let $M$ be a multi-tape Turing machine, $c$ a configuration, and $t\in\mathbb{N}$. If the configuration reached after $t$ steps is not halted, then for every $u\in\mathbb{N}$ with $u\le t$, the configuration reached after $u$ steps is not halted.
hypotheses_covered: the configuration after $t$ steps is not halted
